player_0.content: New plan: I failed to count the fruits in the last question because I didn't consider the possibility of a fruit being mentioned multiple times. In the question "I have an orange, a raspberry, two peaches, a blackberry, an apple, a grape, a nectarine, and three plums. How many fruits do I have?", I should have counted the peaches and plums as multiple fruits. Next time, I will make sure to count each fruit individually, even if it is mentioned multiple times.
